titulo: Guessing your name for a year
caption:
Guessing your name for a year

Cella guessed how to say her name for a whole year.

Most people would rather be asked how their name is said than hear it wrong for years.

For the friend who asks how to say it.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes on the left tries three versions of a name in speech bubbles, one after another, while a royal blue figure on the right tilts and narrows its eyes politely each time. At the end the black one's eyes go wide and it trembles, and the blue one's eyes turn happy. The text changes from: me guessing your name for a year, to: asked once. said right ever since.
